Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer gives the average height of the four mountains in meters (5,297.75 meters). The Ground Truth Answer provides the average in feet (17,382 ft). To compare, convert 5,297.75 meters to feet:

5,297.75 meters × 3.28084 = 17,382.11 feet

This shows that the average given in the Predicted Answer is numerically equivalent to the Ground Truth Answer, just expressed in a different unit. The substance and vital fact (the correct average height) is present in the Predicted Answer.
